summary: Backend testing completed for lesson progress endpoints. All 7/7 tests passed. The bug fix for lesson progress saving to Supabase is working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test lessons created with prefix 'TEST_' during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lesson progress endpoints verified working. POST /api/lessons/progress saves lesson completions to Supabase lesson_progress table (columns: user_id, lesson_id, completed_at, created_at - NO program_id column). GET /api/lessons/progress returns list of completed lessons. Duplicate protection working. Auth required on both endpoints. Test user testlesson@test.com exists and has several completed lessons for testing.

features_verified.POST_lessons_progress_duplicate: PASS - Returns {message, already_completed:true} for same lesson_id
features_verified.Optional_program_id: PASS - Endpoint accepts optional program_id (not stored in DB)

notes: The original bug (lesson progress not being saved) was due to program_id column not existing in Supabase lesson_progress table. The fix removed program_id from the insert query. All endpoints now working correctly with real Supabase database.
